pages.title: The Courier Network
pages.text: OreSpawn's dimensions have no portals to build — they have staff. Certain insects tunnel between worlds and will carry any traveler who right-clicks them with an $(4)empty hand$().$(p)Meet them near their spawn blocks: place an ant block you've dug up, and couriers crawl out on their own schedule.

pages.title: Routes
pages.text: $(li)Ant → Utopia$(li)Red Ant → Mining Dimension$(li)Rainbow Ant → Village Dimension$(li)Unstable Ant → The Islands$(li)Termite → Crystal Dimension$(li)Butterfly → Chaos$(p)Clicking the same species inside its destination brings you home to the Overworld. The Utopia Portal block offers a more dignified route to Utopia.
Management. Tips are appreciated but not required.
